title: Braided cochain lift with prescribed inverse tensorator and unit
statement: Let C and D be preadditive braided monoidal categories with zero objects, monoidal preadditivity, and the graded tensor existence, four-object extensionality and good triple-tensor hypotheses of the signed cochain tensor construction. Let G:C→D be an additive strong braided functor preserving each coproduct indexed by the fiber of integer addition over a degree. Then its cochain lift admits a strong braided structure c. On any pair P,Q, a morphism f from G(P⊗Q) to GP⊗GQ is the inverse tensorator of c if its composite with every total summand is the ordinary inverse tensorator followed by that summand. The inverse unit of c is the single-complex comparison followed by the single of the ordinary inverse unit.

proof.text: Use the existing mapCochainComplexMonoidal construction for the strong monoidal cochain lift. Apply degreewise total-summand extensionality to the braiding equation. The signed braiding formulas have the same Koszul factor; additivity transports this integer scalar, and the ordinary braided equation identifies the remaining maps. Cancel the strong inverse tensorator to conclude that the lifted functor is braided.

For a candidate inverse tensorator f, apply degreewise total-summand extensionality again. The formula map_ιMapBifunctor_mapBifunctorComparisonX identifies the canonical inverse tensorator on each summand with precisely the assumed formula for f. Its unit formula is the defining inverse of mapCochainComplexεIso. Package the constructed braided structure with these two equations. Zero objects and zero coefficient specializations require no additional assumption.

theorem braided_cochain_normalization [G.Braided] :
    ∃ c : (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).Braided,
      (∀ (P Q : CochainComplex C ℤ)
        (f : (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj (P ⊗ Q) ⟶
          (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P ⊗ (G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q),
        (∀ (p q n : ℤ) (hpq : p + q = n),
          G.map (ιTensorObj P Q p q n hpq) ≫ f.f n =
            δ G (P.X p) (Q.X q) ≫ ιTensorObj
              ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj P)
              ((G.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj Q) p q n hpq) →
        c.toMonoidal.toOplaxMonoidal.δ P Q = f) ∧
      c.toMonoidal.toOplaxMonoidal.η =
        ((singleMapHomologicalComplex G (.up ℤ) (0 : ℤ)).app (𝟙_ C)).hom ≫
          (single D (.up ℤ) (0 : ℤ)).map (Functor.OplaxMonoidal.η G)
